repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 牙齦纖維瘤病主要由 SOS1/HMGA2 基因突變或遺傳因素驅動，無已知 ALK 過表達或融合證據。TxGNN 高分可能反映知識圖譜中「纖維增生」類節點與 Alectinib 的間接關聯，而非直接機轉。
孤立性纖維性腫瘤（SFT）偶見 ALK 表達，但肺部纖維瘤多為良性，臨床上不需要系統性激酶抑制治療。無任何支持性臨床資料。
肺錯構瘤為良性發育異常，涉及間葉組織成分（軟骨、脂肪、肌肉），無已知 ALK 通路參與。預測可能源於知識圖譜中肺部病灶節點的結構相似性。

In this article the authors review the neuroimaging, pathology, genetics, and therapeutic interventions for FTD spectrum disorders.

literature.abstract: This article reviews many of the complex facets of behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). A particular focus is on improving diagnostic accuracy to reduce the arduous diagnostic odyssey that so many patients and families endure. Strategies to promote diagnostic accuracy and approach the management of problematic symptoms are also discussed.
